fullContent:
Karpooradi Churna 
 Reference – Sahasra Yoga, Churna prakarana, 23. 
 Introduction 
 Karpooradi Churna is an ayurvedic formulation which consists of several herbs. These herbs are very effective in case of digestive and respiratory diseases. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Sugar 
 Twak – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Camphor – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Jatiphala – Myristica fragrans 
 Jatidala – Myristica fragrans’s fruit pericarp 
 Takkola – Dalbergia lanceolaria 
 Nagakeshara – Mesua ferrea 
 Clove – Syzygium aromaticum    
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinale 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the ingredients in proper given proportion. These proportions are camphor, takkola, jatidala, twak and jatiphala up to 10 grams, clove up to 20 grams, maricha up to 40 grams, dry ginger 60 grams and nagakeshara up to 30 grams. 
 Now made the powder of all herbs individually and mix to make Karpooradi Churna. 
 
 Dose 
 One to three grams with sugar and water, one or two times a day after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Indigestion 
 Cold and cough 
 Anorexia 
 Difficulty in breathing 
 Nausea 
 Pain 
 Vomiting 
 
 Contraindications 
 High doses can cause gastric irritation. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
